messages:
lina: ASYNC check-in — quick standup (audits / vuln remediation / IAM/KMS)

lina: Did: completed permissions audit for staging-keystore, escalated CVE-2026-1102 in tokenizer-lib (container-image), opened PR #1284 to pin deps and narrow iam policy for renderer-service.

lina: Blocker: KMS rotation validation for prod-main fails on decrypt step with AccessDenied for role arn:aws:iam::555111:role/renderer-service. Dry-run halts at step 2/3.

lina: Today: request scoped grant for rotation window, re-run validation, add diagnosis section to runbook, and pair-review PR #1284.

joel: on it — paste the error log and the exact role ARN

lina: error:
```
2026-03-10T08:12:47Z ERROR rotation: decrypt failure: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::555111:assumed-role/renderer-service/i-0b2c3d4e is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555111:key/ee77-ff88
```
role: arn:aws:iam::555111:role/renderer-service

ryan: added a retry to the rotation client to handle transient auth propagation delays — commit `b7c2a9`. Might help if this is eventual-consistency.

vault-bot: [alert] 2026-03-10T08:13:01Z — rotation attempt failed on prod/main: AccessDenied for arn:aws:iam::555111:role/renderer-service

joel: granted kms:Decrypt for arn:aws:iam::555111:role/renderer-service scoped to request tag `rotation=true` and time window 10m. Re-run and report.

lina: re-ran dry-run — success. All steps completed. Will merge PR #1284 after a final quick review and add the KMS troubleshooting notes to the runbook: https://confluence.redwood/security/rotations. Will reference SEC-3001 in the PR.

ryan: once merged I can coordinate a 15m canary with eng-sre. ping for a slot.

lina: merged at 3961234620. Blocker resolved, updating ticket SEC-3001 and posting EOD with logs and runbook diff. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: deploy-note: PR #1284 merged to main by lina at 2026-03-10T08:22:10Z — staging image build queued.
